name: Carry Quintile Roll Yield Analysis — ZC & ZS
description: Carry quintile analysis using normalized carry = (M1-M2)/M1 via spread_depth=1. Each day is ranked into quintiles (Q1=deepest contango, Q5=deepest backwardation) using a rolling 252-day percentile rank to avoid look-ahead bias. Two continuations: NoAdjustment for carry/regime classification, BackwardRatio for clean 63-day forward returns. Outputs: (1) Stats table with obs count, avg carry, avg next-quarter yield, and hit rate per quintile; (2) Bar chart of avg next-quarter roll yield by quintile to test monotonicity.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CARRY QUINTILE ROLL YIELD ANALYSIS — ZC & ZS
# =============================================================================
# Quintile sort on normalized carry = (M1 - M2) / M1:
#   Q1 = deepest contango (percentile rank 0-20)
#   Q2 = moderate contango (20-40)
#   Q3 = neutral (40-60)
#   Q4 = moderate backwardation (60-80)
#   Q5 = deepest backwardation (80-100)
#
# Rolling 252-day percentile rank avoids look-ahead bias.
# Tests whether deeper backwardation monotonically predicts
# superior next-quarter (63-day) forward returns.
#
# Two continuations per asset:
#   1. NoAdjustment + spread_depth=1 — for carry signal & quintile ranking
#   2. BackwardRatio — for clean forward returns (roll yield proxy)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data: NoAdjustment for carry/regime ---
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    spread_depth=1
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Data: BackwardRatio for forward returns ---
cont_adj = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Carry signal: (M1 - M2) / M1 ---
carry_signal = cont.spread / cont.c

# --- Rolling 252-day percentile rank of carry (0-100 scale) ---
carry_pctrank = percentrank(period=252)(carry_signal)

# --- Quintile classification ---
is_q1 = carry_pctrank <= 20
is_q2 = carry_pctrank > 20 and carry_pctrank <= 40
is_q3 = carry_pctrank > 40 and carry_pctrank <= 60
is_q4 = carry_pctrank > 60 and carry_pctrank <= 80
is_q5 = carry_pctrank > 80

# --- Next-quarter (63-day) forward return as roll yield proxy ---
fwd_63d = forward_returns(period=63)(cont_adj.c)

# --- Quintile-conditional metrics ---
# Avg carry by quintile
carry_q1 = where(is_q1, carry_signal)
carry_q2 = where(is_q2, carry_signal)
carry_q3 = where(is_q3, carry_signal)
carry_q4 = where(is_q4, carry_signal)
carry_q5 = where(is_q5, carry_signal)

# Avg forward return by quintile
fwd_q1 = where(is_q1, fwd_63d)
fwd_q2 = where(is_q2, fwd_63d)
fwd_q3 = where(is_q3, fwd_63d)
fwd_q4 = where(is_q4, fwd_63d)
fwd_q5 = where(is_q5, fwd_63d)

# Hit rate: % of quintile days where next-quarter return > 0
hit_q1 = where(is_q1 and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q2 = where(is_q2 and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q3 = where(is_q3 and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q4 = where(is_q4 and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)
hit_q5 = where(is_q5 and is_valid(fwd_63d), 1.0 if fwd_63d > 0 else 0.0)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: Quintile Statistics Table
# Columns: Obs Count, Avg Carry, Avg Next-Qtr Yield, Hit Rate
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Carry Quintile Statistics (Rolling 252d Rank)',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Q1 — Deepest Contango', 'Q2 — Moderate Contango', 'Q3 — Neutral', 'Q4 — Moderate Backwardation', 'Q5 — Deepest Backwardation'],
        col_headers=['Obs Count', 'Avg Carry', 'Avg Next-Qtr Yield', 'Hit Rate'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Quintile Summary',
    order=0
)(carry_q1, carry_q1, fwd_q1, hit_q1, carry_q2, carry_q2, fwd_q2, hit_q2, carry_q3, carry_q3, fwd_q3, hit_q3, carry_q4, carry_q4, fwd_q4, hit_q4, carry_q5, carry_q5, fwd_q5, hit_q5)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: Avg Next-Quarter Roll Yield by Carry Quintile
# Tests monotonicity: Q5 should show highest return if carry is predictive
# =============================================================================
xy_bars(
    title='Next-Quarter Roll Yield by Carry Quintile',
    category='2. Monotonicity Test',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg 63-Day Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q1 Contango', color=Color.Red),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q2', color=Color.Orange),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q3 Neutral', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q4', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Q5 Backwardation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(fwd_q1, fwd_q2, fwd_q3, fwd_q4, fwd_q5))
